collection.title: Citroen C3 Aircross 2017 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen C3 Aircross 2017 - 2022 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. we also have rear wiper blades for this C3 Aircross - simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
